rooms-v5/bridge: ART DIRECTION: in the style of Fortiche Production's Riot Games cinematics ('Get Jinxed', 'Warriors', the Arcane series) — 3D characters with hand-painted textures, 2D-animation sensibility. FIRST-PERSON SET PAINTING for a point-and-click game: eye level, standing inside the room, wide 24mm lens, no people, no text, no UI; every object named below must be clearly visible and readable as a clickable prop. Colour key: blue-white with amber console light. The bridge of the old cargo freighter Marlow. Three pilot consoles in a row, two dark, one alive with amber readouts; a docking countdown glows on every screen; a small navigation tablet rests on the live console. Forward viewport: slow starfield and the distant lights of a port station. Hatch to the corridor on the left, airlock hatch on the right. Series palette: indigo-violet #2b2a5e, blue-white #cfe3ff, gold #d9b56a. STYLE (fixed): A single frame from a stylized 3D animated feature film — sculpted characters and sets with clean solid geometry, correct perspective and real volume. Form shading is fully 3D: one directional key light with cast shadows and contact shadows, ambient occlusion in the folds, subtle subsurface scattering on skin, one hard coloured rim light for separation, volumetric haze and light shafts, a cinematic 35mm lens with shallow depth of field. Surfaces carry HAND-PAINTED TEXTURES: visible brush marks, dry-brush wear, grime and chipped paint live inside the texture maps — the strokes follow the surface, they never replace the form. Faces are sculpted and readable: sharp planes, defined jaw, slightly enlarged eyes with a wet specular; hair is modelled as chunky sculpted clumps with painted strands. No ink outlines. Palette muted with a few saturated accents; two-tone lighting (indigo/gold or teal/amber). Painterly 3D look, like a prestige animated series that paints over its CG. Avoid: flat 2D illustration, oil painting on canvas, canvas grain, watercolour, sketch, photorealism, live-action, anime, cel-shading, lineart, extra text.
